page.overview:
Who is Arthur Fizzlebottom?

is a Christmas elf Rogue played by Taliesin Jaffe for .

Arthur has a pointy nose, messy black hair, and pointy ears that stick out of his striped hat, with the same design on his shirt.

Arthur stated that he wishes he had the flu, so he didn't have to be there.

(After getting a HDYWTDT) "Careful of the choking hazard!"
